lead: Kota Srinivasa Rao was an actor, born on 10 July 1942 in Vijayawada.
He died on 13 July 2025 in Hyderabad at the age of 83.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has held the office of Member of the Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly.
The sections that follow break down Kota Srinivasa Rao's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

paras: Kota Srinivasa Rao was born on 10 July 1942 in Vijayawada, and holds citizenship of British Raj and India.

sections.heading: Kota Srinivasa Rao — Career and Professional Work
paras: Kota Srinivasa Rao works primarily as an actor and politician.
He has held the following offices: Member of the Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly (1999–2004). He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
